facts.fact: 开场定锚：1984-08-27 缅因酷暑，Little Canada 的 Babs Dionne 二十九岁，头一回担心自己要疯。
facts.anchor: Your name was Babs Dionne, and for the first time in your twenty-nine years of existence, you had reason to worry you might be losing your mind.

facts.fact: Mill 如神：1900 年起近百年日产 240 吨纸；大萧条时沃特维尔无一人失业；如今「抛弃」全镇，烟囱影子像日晷扫过市中心。
facts.anchor: Since 1900 it had rolled out every page of every newspaper in the United States: 240 tons of paper a day, 365 days a year, for nearly a century.

facts.fact: 房子自她十九岁那年母亲死于亨廷顿病起归她所有；她独自在家。
facts.anchor: The house had belonged to you since your mother died of Huntington’s disease when you were nineteen.

facts.fact: 丈夫 Rheal 前一天去北林，跟 Saucier 兄弟划 Allagash 河、篝火边灌威士忌，躲开邻里一年半来的紧张与悲伤。
facts.anchor: canoeing the Allagash River and drinking whiskey by firelight with the Saucier brothers

facts.fact: 死去十年的母亲 Rose 首次显灵，像做完头发回来似的坐上厨房桌——讨咖啡、点烟，烟酒在她指间凭空成形。
facts.anchor: she’d merely been out having her hair set for an extremely long time

facts.fact: 第六感先例一：1968-02-01，十三岁的她先于春节攻势任何报道「知道」哥哥 Jean 在岘港中狙身亡。
facts.anchor: you’d awakened with the knowledge that your older brother, Jean, had been killed by sniper fire at Da Nang

facts.fact: Sacha 曾性侵她、她反手刺穿其肺——母亲判词「受害者只算那几秒」；她自那日起发誓不再伤人，至今守住。
facts.anchor: If you were a victim, it was only for the few seconds between when Sacha finished his business and you stabbed him in the lung.

facts.fact: 母亲的使命宣告：更大的考验将至，邻居需要她领导；接受「杀手」身份的代价是被恨、被猎杀、最终赔上性命——说完人就消失了，留给她的咖啡杯倒扣时诡异地全空。
facts.anchor: Sacha made you a killer. The only choice you have is whether to accept what you are, and what you must do.
